products.title: Everybody Scream
products.body_html:
Release on 7 PM CT Friday 4/24.

Everybody Scream is a deep purple jelly with fiery red to copper to gold shimmer, gold holographic microsparks, and holographic microflakes.

Inspired by the song Everybody Scream.

When I first saw the song name I thought it was about how everyone shared an urge to scream. Now that I’ve actually listened to it many times, looked at the lyrics, I love that she’s talking about how she feels on stage. I love this part for her:

“Here, I can take up the whole of the sky
Unfurling, becoming my full size
And look at me burst through the ceiling.”

products.title: Howl
products.body_html:
Release on 7 PM CT Friday 4/24.


Howl is a violet jelly with cyan to to blue to purple shimmer, holographic microflakes, chartreuse holographic microsparks and purple holographic microsparks.

Inspired by the song Howl.

Howl was the first song I ever heard by Florence + the Machine. The lyrics are intense and sung so beautifully. 

“Now there's no holding back, I'm making to attack
My blood is singing with your voice, I want to pour it out
The saints can't help me now, the ropes have been unbound
I hunt for you with bloodied feet across the hallowed ground.”

Next she warns:

”Be careful of the curse that falls on young lovers
Starts so soft and sweet and turns them to hunters
A man who is pure at heart and says his prayers by night
May still become a wolf when the autumn moon is bright.”

products.title: Neodymium Bar Magnet
products.body_html:
Sold individually.  While most magnets will work in use with magnetic nail polish a strong neodymium magnet is recommend for a clean, tight line. 

How to use this bar magnet with magnetic nail polish

  1.  Prep nails with your favorite base coat.
  2. Apply 1 coat of Magnetic nail polish to all nails and let dry.
  3. Apply a second thick coat of magnetic polish on only one nail. Polish should be thick but not dripping.
  4. Immediately after applying the second coat hold the magnet 1/4th inch away from nail at a diagonal angle for magnetic design to go across the nail as pictured. Hold magnet for 20-30 seconds. Keep in mind the longer and closer you hold the magnet over your nail the stronger and clearer the design will be).
  5. Repeat with third coat if desired, holding the magnet over this coat as you did with the previous.
  6. Finish with your favorite top coat and again hold the magnet over the polish for 20-30 seconds after applying top coat.
  7. As the polish dries the design will spread out slightly. Again, the longer you hold the magnet in the previous steps the less it will spread.

 Photo credit to Kimberley Instagram
